42618-the-lady-of-lynn.description: A book by Sir Walter Besant. The happiest day of my life, up to that time, because I should be the basest and the most ungrateful of men were I not to confess that I have since enjoyed many days far excelling in happiness that day, was the 20th day of June, in the year of grace, seventeen hundred and forty-seven.

She was a brunette, with a rather high forehead, the height of which was ingeniously broken by two short locks upon the temples.

arxiv-1707-01408.title: Video Representation Learning and Latent Concept Mining for Large-scale Multi-label Video Classification
arxiv-1707-01408.creator: Po-Yao Huang, Ye Yuan, Zhenzhong Lan, Lu Jiang, Alexander G. Hauptmann
arxiv-1707-01408.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Po-Yao Huang, Ye Yuan, Zhenzhong Lan, Lu Jiang, Alexander G. Hauptmann. We report on CMU Informedia Lab’s system used in Google’s YouTube 8 Million Video Understanding Challenge. In this multi-label video classification task, our pipeline achieved 84.675% and 84.662% GAP on our evaluation split and the official test set. We attribute the good performance to three components: 1) Refined video representation learning with residual links and hypercolumns 2) Latent concept mining which captures interactions among concepts.

arxiv-2109-11493.title: Asymptotic stability analysis of Riemann-Liouville fractional stochastic neutral differential equations
arxiv-2109-11493.creator: Arzu Ahmadova, Nazim I. Mahmudov
arxiv-2109-11493.description: Abstract The novelty of our paper is to establish results on asymptotic stability of mild solutions in p p th moment to Riemann-Liouville fractional stochastic neutral differential equations (for short Riemann-Liouville FSNDEs) of order α ∈ ( 1 2 , 1 ) \alpha\in(\frac{1}{2},1) using a Banach’s contraction mapping principle.

arxiv-2303-08855.title: Refined Bohr inequality for functions in ℂ n \mathbb{C}^{n} and in complex Banach spaces
arxiv-2303-08855.creator: Sabir Ahammed, Molla Basir Ahamed ∗
arxiv-2303-08855.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sabir Ahammed, Molla Basir Ahamed ∗. In this paper, we first obtain a refined version of the Bohr inequality of norm-type for holomorphic mappings with lacunary series on the polydisk in ℂ n \mathbb{C}^{n} under some restricted conditions. Next, we determine the refined version of the Bohr inequality for holomorphic functions defined on a balanced domain G G of a complex Banach space X X and take values from the unit disk 𝔻 \mathbb{D} .

arxiv-2311-09923.title: Branch-and-Price for the Stochastic TSP with Generalized Latency
arxiv-2311-09923.creator: Benedikt Lienkamp, Mike Hewitt, Maximilian Schiffer
arxiv-2311-09923.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Benedikt Lienkamp, Mike Hewitt, Maximilian Schiffer. Motivated by the tactical planning level of demand adaptive public transportation systems, we present the stochastic symmetric traveling salesman problem with generalized latency (STSP-GL), a stochastic extension to the symmetric traveling salesman problem with generalized latency (TSP-GL). The STSP-GL aims to choose a subset of nodes of an undirected graph and determines a Hamiltonian tour amongst those nodes, minimizing an objective function that is a weighted combination of route design and passenger routing costs.

arxiv-2407-12143.title: False Consensus Biases AI Against Vulnerable Stakeholders
arxiv-2407-12143.creator: Mengchen Dong, Jean-François Bonnefon, Iyad Rahwan
arxiv-2407-12143.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mengchen Dong, Jean-François Bonnefon, Iyad Rahwan. The deployment of AI systems for welfare benefit allocation allows for accelerated decision-making and faster provision of critical help, but has already led to an increase in unfair benefit denials and false fraud accusations. Collecting data in the US and the UK ( N = 2 449 N=2\ 449 ), we explore the public acceptability of such speed-accuracy trade-offs in populations of claimants and non-claimants.

arxiv-2503-17260.title: Contact process for the spread of knowledge
arxiv-2503-17260.creator: Nicolas Lanchier, Max Mercer, Hyunsik Yun
arxiv-2503-17260.description: Abstract This paper is concerned with a natural variant of the contact process modeling the spread of knowledge on the integer lattice. Each site is characterized by its knowledge, measured by a real number ranging from 0 = ignorant to 1 = omniscient.

arxiv-2511-21332.title: Helical Quasiperiodic Chains with Engineered Dissipation: Liouvillian Rapidity Diagnostics of Transport and Localization
arxiv-2511-21332.creator: Mohammad Pouranvari
arxiv-2511-21332.description: Abstract We study relaxation spectra of a quadratic spinless-fermion “helical” chain with an Aubry–André–type quasiperiodic potential and a single N N -th neighbor (helical) hopping. Dissipation and pumping are introduced via local linear Lindblad jump operators and treated exactly using the third-quantization / Majorana covariance formalism.

pmc-10629863.title: Gallstone as a cause of intestinal obstruction (Bouveret syndrome)
pmc-10629863.creator: Emerson Leonardo Monteiro, Johannes Schmid, Hans Jörg Mischinger, Robert Sucher, Peter Kornprat
pmc-10629863.description: Gallstone ileus is a rare cause of bowel obstruction. Here we report about two cases with clinical findings and therapy options. Both patients were presented with typical ileus-like symptoms, although the surgical treatment differs due to the CT scan and intraoperative findings. There are many methods for treating patients with Bouveret syndrome.

pmc-11353121.title: Is Oxytocin a Contributor to Behavioral and Metabolic Features in Prader–Willi Syndrome?
pmc-11353121.creator: Maria Petersson, Charlotte Höybye, Claudia Camerino
pmc-11353121.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Prader–Willi Syndrome (PWS) is a rare genetic disorder typically characterized by decreased social interaction, hyperphagia, poor behavioral control and temper tantrums, together with a high risk of morbid obesity unless food intake is controlled. The genetic defects that cause PWS include paternal 15q deletion (estimated in 60% of cases), chromosome 15 maternal uniparental disomy (UPD) (estimated in 35% of cases) and imprinting defects and translocations. Several studies indicate an oxytocin deficiency in PWS.

pmc-11600935.title: The Potential Protective Role of Ascorbic Acid Against Testicular Toxicity Induced by Fluoxetine in Male Wistar Rats
pmc-11600935.creator: Joshua Ojodale Aruwa, Sunday Agba Bisong, Kebe Obeten, Ekom Monday Etukudo, Neeza Timothy, Theophilus Gbednet Kureh, Godwin Aiyabalu Okoruwa, Theophilus Pius, Ibe Michael Usman
pmc-11600935.description: BackgroundFluoxetine (FLX) is a Selective Serotonin Re-uptake Inhibitor (SSRI) commonly used as a first-line treatment for depression, anxiety, and mood disorders. It can cause infertility in the male reproductive system through the release of Reactive Oxygen Species (ROS). This study aimed to evaluate the testiculo-protective potential of ascorbic acid against fluoxetine-induced spermatotoxicity in male Wistar rats.

pmc-11712045.title: Associations between cognitive enhancement therapy in old age and temporal‐spatial orientation and language: A case study
pmc-11712045.creator: Antonia Tziannarou, Constantinos Christodoulides, Andrea Hadjiloizou, Sotiria Moza
pmc-11712045.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAn 84‐year‐old male, with 16 years of education (retired physics teacher) was admitted to a long‐term rehabilitation centre to receive daily care, with cognitive decline symptoms. This study presents the data from a three‐month cognitive enhancement program.MethodsIn September 2023, the patient underwent the Mini Mental State Examination (MMSE) in Greek, followed by cognitive enhancement sessions (45 minutes, twice a week) for three months.

pmc-12693770.title: Study on the Tensile Properties and Waterproofing Mechanism of Bamboo Fibers Treated by Different Methods
pmc-12693770.creator: Chuncheng Sun, Haiying Cao, Enhua Zhang, Jiefeng Liu
pmc-12693770.description: Bamboo fibers have received significant attention due to their biodegradability and environmental benefits. However, their inherent hydrophilicity causes dramatic degradation in mechanical properties after water absorption. Some methods have been adopted to treat bamboo fiber to address this challenge, e.g., sodium hydroxide (NaOH) solution treatment, vegetable oil treatment, and carboxylated styrene butadiene rubber (XSBR) treatment.

pmc-12987868.title: Computational chemistry methods based on MNDO and tools for improving their accuracy
pmc-12987868.creator: James J. P. Stewart
pmc-12987868.description: ContextSemiempirical computational methods based on the MNDO approximation have a long history. Since its release in 1977, the original MNDO method has evolved steadily, passing through several forms (AM1, PM3, etc.) up to the present. Each new form represented an improvement, and it is anticipated that the evolution will continue for many more years.

pmc-13145412.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1363 MICROBIOTA IN ACUTE ISCHEMIC STROKE: PRELIMINARY CLINICAL AND NEUROPSYCHOLOGICAL FINDINGS FROM A PROSPECTIVE COHORT
pmc-13145412.creator: Diana Lucía Tarruella Hernández, Alicia Aliena-Valero, Maria Castelló-Ruiz, Manuel Pedrero-Prieto, Lluis Morales Caba, Gerardo Fortea, Juan Manuel Sanchis García, Victor Vázquez-Añón Pérez, Fernando Aparici, Juan Bautista Salom Sanvalero, Jose Ignacio Tembl, Irene Escudero Martínez
pmc-13145412.description: Background and aimsExperimental and clinical evidence suggests that gut, oral and systemic microbiota may influence inflammation, vascular dysfunction and post-stroke recovery. However, microbial patterns across different biological compartments and their association with clinical outcomes remain underexplored, particularly in patients undergoing reperfusion therapies. We conducted a prospective, multimodal cohort that integrated clinical, neuroimaging, neuropsychological and, biological data.

pmc-13229002.title: A Case Report of Rabies in an HIV Patient: Diagnostic Challenges and Near-Miss Recognition
pmc-13229002.creator: Lele Yu, Hu Wan, Zhongdong Zhang, Jinchuan Shi, Dingyan Yan
pmc-13229002.description: IntroductionRabies is a fatal viral zoonosis. It typically manifests as furious or paralytic encephalomyelitis. Diagnosis is challenging, especially with atypical presentations, low viral loads, or immunocompromise. HIV co-infection may further obscure the clinical picture.Case PresentationA 53-year-old man with well-controlled HIV presented with dizziness, fever, and headache, then rapidly developed right hemiparesis, dysarthria, and behavioral changes.

pmc-13286360.title: How the desert ant Cataglyphis fortis uses its nest hill for homing
pmc-13286360.creator: Lin Jiang, Markus Knaden
pmc-13286360.description: The desert ant Cataglyphis fortis relies on path integration and environmental cues for navigation. In featureless environments, nest hills serve as landmarks that enhance homing success. We found that homing ants can discriminate their own nest hills from others based on visual cues.

pmc-13382060.title: Housing affordability and psychological distress: Household measures mirror individual estimates but miss one in three at-risk adults
pmc-13382060.creator: Kazuya Ogawa, Keiichi Shimatani, Kohki Takaguchi, Norimichi Suzuki
pmc-13382060.description: ObjectiveConventional household-based housing affordability measures assume equal burden-sharing, potentially diluting or obscuring health risks of individuals with disproportionate burdens. To examine the implications of this assumption in research and preventive policy, we investigated the respective associations of household and individual housing affordability with psychological distress.

pmc-13672385.title: Barriers and Facilitators to Implementing Evidence-Based Breastfeeding Support in Miami-Dade County Maternity Wards
pmc-13672385.creator: Cynthia Lebron, Vanessa Morales, Alexa Parra, Sydney Litten
pmc-13672385.description: ObjectivesThis qualitative study assessed the breastfeeding environment across all 12 maternity hospitals in Miami-Dade County, Florida, to identify institutional factors that influence breastfeeding support.MethodsInterviews were conducted with lactation consultants and nurses and analyzed using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR).ResultsHospitals varied substantially in adherence to Baby-Friendly Hospital Initiative (BFHI) guidelines, regardless of official designation.
